nodes.title: Scene 09 — A place at the table

properties.global_prompt:
Photorealistic live-action first-century biblical drama. Match each supplied starting image for exact character identity, wardrobe, time of day, location and lighting. Each timeline segment is one continuous take; cuts between segments carry changes of viewpoint or time. Use restrained human performances and purposeful smooth camera movement at natural real-time speed. Preserve prop ownership and completed actions. Speak only the exact assigned lines, once each, with a consistent English voice per character across all scenes. Keep speaking faces large and sharp. No narration, subtitles or invented dialogue. Sound follows its physical source and distance.

properties.local_prompts:
One continuous 15-second live-action shot. Begin directly from the supplied image. Tight head-and-shoulders two-shot at the stocked market cloth stall: younger left and Damon right, large sharp faces on the same focal plane. Damon’s fingers hold the upper edge of the cloth bolt at bottom of frame after steadying it; his lips are poised to comment on younger’s russet mantle. Younger watches him; market awning softly legible behind, no establishing-wide framing. Photorealistic live-action35mm anamorphic 2.39:1 frame, no text or labels. Use supplied references for exact cast and geography.

Camera: Restrained continuous 85mm close-up tracking or short pan; faces remain large and sharp throughout speaking, no inside cut. Observational side-track through market traffic, coming to rest by the cloth display.
Action: The market continues around the stranger. Younger stops at a cloth stall; Damon steadies a falling bolt, notices the russet and comments. Younger looks down and asks his advice.
End state: Same tight 85mm two-shot. Younger has lowered his gaze briefly to the russet edge at his chest then raises his eyes toward Damon, lips just parted to ask advice, self-conscious but composed. Damon faces him with natural confidence. Both heads fill the frame vertically and stay sharp, cloth still at lower edge. Photorealistic live-action35mm anamorphic 2.39:1 frame, no text or labels. Preserve first-frame cast, costumes, light and camera axis.
Performance and dialogue: DAMON: That color will trouble you in the heat.
YOUNGER SON: What would you choose?
Only the explicitly assigned dialogue is spoken once by its named speaker; all other descriptions are acting directions, never narration. Keep speaking faces large and sharp, with natural synchronized lips and pauses. Maintain a single continuous take and consistent movement speed.
Continuity: Younger still wears russet on arrival. Same stocked street retained for later famine; no monumental fantasy city. Damon hospitable and confident, not a villain caricature. Keep personal bedroll and repaired waterskin with younger. Mandatory dialogue close-up: talking faces large and sharp, no wide coverage during speech.

overall_soundscape: Natural sound belonging to this location and the visible action: restrained cloth and footsteps, appropriate room tone or outdoor air; animals and objects only where present. Sound falls off with distance. Retain explicitly described sound cues above. No invented speech, vocal loops or chanting.
non_diegetic_music: N/A | One continuous 15-second live-action shot. Begin directly from the supplied image. Daylight shaded cloth stall. Damon lifts a light natural-wool mantle with one narrow blue border into the space between himself and younger. Younger still wears his fine russet gift over his ordinary tunic; his eyes follow Damon’s assured hand. His bedroll rests against his leg and the waterskin hangs from its strap. Only these two faces are prominent.

Camera: Slow intimate push on the two men and the cloth between them.
Action: Damon shows the lighter blue-bordered mantle. Younger admires the fabric and the confidence of its presentation, selecting it without a flashy exchange or costume-change montage.
End state: Same continuous two-shot, younger now holds the folded light mantle with its narrow blue border across his forearms while looking to Damon with an appreciative small smile. Damon’s hand lightly indicates the fabric’s edge. The russet mantle remains visibly on younger’s shoulders; no wardrobe change has occurred inside the shot.
Performance and dialogue: No dialogue. Characters remain silent.

A filled clay cup stands in front of him; repaired waterskin and packed folded blue-bordered mantle stay at his seat.
